name: Renewal notices
description: Create renewal reminders and notifications for policies expiring within the configured notice windows

name: Policy expiry
description: Mark policies past their expiry date as expired

name: Quotation expiry
description: Expire quotations older than the configured validity

name: Receivable ageing
description: Recompute ageing buckets for open receivables and notify collections

name: Daily reports
description: Generate the scheduled daily reports (production register, collections, claims position)

name: Renewal notice queue
description: Send queued renewal notices and retry stale jobs

name: Renewal pipeline
description: Enrol policies expiring within the pipeline window and lapse renewals past the grace period

name: Collection reminders
description: E-mail and notify clients about premiums falling due

name: Housekeeping
description: Purge old job runs, sent e-mails, sign-in history, expired sessions and reset codes, read notifications, completed queue jobs, finished integration messages and attempts, inbound messages, EIS submissions and go-live workbook rows after the retention periods in Master > Configuration (Data Retention); pending rows and the audit trail are kept

name: Dormant accounts
description: Deactivate active accounts with no sign-in within the dormancy period (the built-in administrator excepted)

name: Remittance schedules
description: Run the remittance schedules of Accounts > Remittance > Scheduling whose next run date has come: draft remittances per insurer for the policies up to the cut-off date, then move the next run date on by the frequency. Disabled until switched on here

name: My Work reminders
description: Create follow-up tasks from collection promises to pay, renewal next steps and claim follow-up dates, close those whose record is closed, and notify task reminders and newly overdue tasks
